how: Walls are the dark lines of the plan image; rooms are the spaces they enclose, with door gaps closed by extending each wall end up to 2 m. The plan was fitted to the ground with a similarity transform on 7 control points (6500EL over floor 2 500EL; 6200EL over floor 2 200EL; 6500ST over floor 2 500ST; 6200ST over floor 2 200ST; 6401ST over floor 2 401ST; 6700ST over floor 2 700ST; 6700EL over floor 2 700EL).
notes: Room numbers are read from the plan's label boxes. Suffixes: CO and CU are corridors, ST stairs, EL elevators (UCLA Space Inventory codes).
